interpretations: For each `order_id` in `Order_Items`, average its non-NULL `product_quantity` values and subtract the average of all non-NULL item quantities across `Order_Items`; return results only when that overall average exists.
For each `order_id` in `Order_Items`, average its non-NULL `product_quantity` values and subtract the average of the per-order averages; give each order equal weight in the overall average.

For each `order_id` in `Order_Items`, treat NULL and blank `product_quantity` values as missing, average the remaining numeric quantities, and compare that average with the average across all remaining items.

For each `order_id` in `Order_Items`, treat NULL, blank, and nonnumeric `product_quantity` values as missing, average the valid numeric quantities, and compare that average with the average of valid quantities across all orders.
In each interpretation, show the order id, its average, and the difference; sort differences descending with missing differences last, and return at most 10 rows.
queries:
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(product_quantity) AS avg_quantity
  FROM Order_Items
)
SELECT oi.order_id,
       AVG(oi.product_quantity) - overall.avg_quantity AS average_difference
FROM Order_Items AS oi
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE overall.avg_quantity IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY oi.order_id

WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT order_id, AVG(product_quantity) AS avg_quantity
  FROM Order_Items
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT order_id,
       avg_quantity - (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) FROM per_order) AS difference
FROM per_order

WITH quantities AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS REAL) AS quantity
  FROM Order_Items
)
SELECT
  order_id,
  AVG(quantity) AS order_average_quantity,
  (SELECT AVG(quantity) FROM quantities) AS overall_average_quantity
FROM quantities
GROUP BY order_id

WITH quantities AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        CASE
            WHEN json_valid(TRIM(product_quantity))
             AND json_type(TRIM(product_quantity)) IN ('integer', 'real')
            THEN CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)
        END AS quantity
    FROM Order_Items
)
SELECT
    order_id,
    AVG(quantity) AS order_average_quantity,
    (SELECT AVG(quantity) FROM quantities) AS overall_average_quantity
FROM quantities
GROUP BY order_id;

WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, AVG(p.unit_price) AS average
  FROM Orders AS o
  LEFT JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id
)
SELECT order_id,
       average,
       average - (SELECT AVG(unit_price) FROM Products) AS difference
FROM order_averages
ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
